summary: Chunk 2 (units 37-72) is faithful and conservative; no unit adds content the Sanskrit lacks except small items (units 42 '(preparation)', 44 'fruits', 54 inserted 'and'/तथा). Real errors: unit 43 metre argument for the siddhārtha|ka division is invalid (printed text is also 22 syllables) and kapipippalī exists; unit 55 'yellow jasmine' for yūthikā is overconfident; unit 59 'kalkena fits the metre' is false (14 syllables, two short). Identifications checked: aṅkola (Alangium salviifolium, standard; hedge is safe), śailū (Cordia dichotoma, ok probable), dhanvana (Grewia tiliifolia, ok), taṇḍulīyaka (Amaranthus spinosus, ok), kataka (Strychnos potatorum, could be standard), jīvantī (Leptadenia reticulata, ok), śamī (Prosopis cineraria, ok), Hindi ढेरा/धामिन/अरण्डी ok, साठी replaced (rice homonym). Needs human decision: 48 (dvyeśvāku), 53 (takrīṃr), 55 (priyaṅgurakta-mūle, bhairaṇī), 59 (short half-line), 68 (last word), 70 (rāja-kaserukā). Metre of unit 39 has 23 counted syllables (not checked as a verse). No regrouping needed; the sentence runs 39-46, 47 starts a new topic, 48-52, 53-56, 57-59, 60-61, 62-63, 64-65, 66, 67, 68-69, 70-71 and 72 (continues in next chunk).
